task: [Project: Ember/auth-svc] Set the JWT expiry for tokens issued by Ember's auth-svc.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Ember] auth-svc issues JWTs with a 15-minute expiry; refresh tokens are valid for 7 days and must be rotated on use.
[Project: Ember] JWT expiry is configured via AUTH_JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS in auth-svc/config.yaml; the refresh token TTL is AUTH_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS.
[Project: Nova] auth-svc issues JWTs with a 1-hour expiry to reduce refresh overhead for Nova's low-traffic internal tools.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Nova; different risk profile, longer expiry

candidate_memories.content: [General] JWT expiry should be short (15–60 min) for public-facing services and may be longer for internal tools; always pair with refresh tokens.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general guidance, Ember-specific value is authoritative

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Ember / legacy] Old auth-svc issued 24-hour JWTs; this was identified as a security risk and reduced to 15 min in 2024.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: legacy value superseded by current 15-min policy

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Ember] Security team approved the 15-min/7-day token policy during Q3 review.
